basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer and software developer from Austin, Texas. I have a keen interest in Norse mythology, which naturally led me to ACValhalla. I enjoy exploring new technologies and cryptocurrency, which led me to UniSwap. Despite my tech-heavy lifestyle, I find solace in reading religious texts and often engage in discussions on AskBibleScholars. I usually browse Reddit during my breaks at work and in the evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy attending local gaming meetups on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from UT Austin, I have a strong foundation in software development and blockchain technology. My interest in gaming and mythology is self-taught, fueled by years of playing video games and reading. I stay updated with tech trends through online courses and forums.
